_note: Five prompts from the game's needs (see findings.md, section 4). duration_s is what the script asks the provider for.

prompts.text: A wooden screen door with a spring closing: a creak as it swings, then a light rattling slap against the frame. Close recording, dry, no room echo, no voices.
A medium-sized dog barking twice, far away behind a fence in a quiet city back lane, muffled and distant, a little outdoor reverb, no other sounds.
A heavy plastic wheelie-bin lid dropped shut: one hollow thud and a short rattle. Close recording, dry, single event, no music.
A single metal coin dropped onto a hard surface and ringing out briefly: a clean bright clink with a short tail. Dry, single event.
A full metal garbage bin tipped over onto asphalt: a heavy crash, the lid clattering off and rolling, a few small items spilling. Outdoors, one event, no voices.
